verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for an online service like Namecheap, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows a self-hostable version of the registrar or DNS platform. The Terraform provider, Go SDK and API sandbox are client tools for Namecheap's hosted service, not a deployable copy of the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
